tasks.title: Scope Definition
tasks.summary: Define AI proxy communication and make the boundary with ordinary individual writing assistance explicit.

draftBrief.title: Scope Definition Brief: AI Proxy Communication
draftBrief.workingDefinition: AI proxy communication occurs when an AI system mediates communication between people by operating on behalf of one or more participants in the communicative exchange. It does more than help one person produce wording: it stands in for, filters, summarizes, translates, rephrases, routes, sequences, or coordinates messages so that another person receives AI-shaped communication as part of interpersonal or group interaction.
draftBrief.scopeRule: Use AI proxy communication when AI is positioned between human communicators and changes how one person's meaning, presence, evidence, request, response, or coordination signal reaches another person or group.
draftBrief.boundaryWithWritingAssistance: Ordinary individual writing assistance stays outside this definition when AI is used privately by one person to brainstorm, draft, polish, or edit their own text, while that person remains the sole communicator responsible for what reaches the audience. The case becomes proxy communication only when the AI-shaped output mediates a relationship between people, represents someone to someone else, or becomes a coordination surface that others rely on.
inScope: An AI summary of a meeting or thread sent to absent teammates because the system represents prior communication to people who were not present.
An AI agent that filters, prioritizes, routes, or answers messages on behalf of a participant because it changes how others can reach or understand that participant.
AI translation, rephrasing, or tone adjustment used in an interpersonal exchange when it materially reshapes how one person is represented to another.
AI coordination support that turns distributed messages into tasks, decisions, handoffs, or next actions for a group.
outOfScope: Private brainstorming, outlining, grammar checking, or style polishing where AI helps one writer prepare text but does not mediate interaction between people.
A private literature summary used only for one researcher's comprehension before any claim is shared with collaborators.
Generic content generation with no interpersonal handoff, representation, routing, translation, or coordination function.
Minor copyediting that leaves the sender's intended message and communicative role unchanged.
edgeCases: AI rewriting an angry email into a diplomatic message is in scope if the rewrite changes how the sender is represented in the interpersonal exchange.
AI grammar checking an email is usually out of scope unless the system substantively alters tone, intent, or relational meaning.
AI summarizing a shared document for a team is in scope when the summary becomes what teammates use to coordinate, but out of scope if it remains private study aid.
operationalTest: Who is being represented, filtered, summarized, translated, or coordinated by the AI?
Who receives or relies on the AI-shaped communication?
What communicative function does the AI perform between people?
Would the case still matter if no other person or group were on the receiving side?
draftBrief.draftSentence: For this review, AI proxy communication refers to AI-mediated arrangements in which a system stands between human communicators by representing, transforming, relaying, filtering, or coordinating communicative acts for one person or group in relation to another. The concept is narrower than individual AI writing assistance: proxy communication requires an interpersonal or collaborative handoff in which AI-shaped output becomes part of how people understand, respond to, or coordinate with one another.
handoffNotes: Noah should tag sources as proxy communication only when they involve interpersonal mediation, representation, filtering, translation, summarization, or coordination.
Lin and Priya should preserve the distinction between proxy communication and private writing assistance unless the team explicitly revises this definition.
Evidence claims still need source-matrix support before final drafting.
